name: Universidade dos Açores
summary: Public island university in the Azores; Ocean Sciences is fully taught in English across Ponta Delgada and Horta.

ib.text: EU/EEA citizens use Portugal's national contest. The 2026 entrance-exam sets used biology, physics and chemistry, geography or mathematics; 2027 IB equivalences are not published yet.

programmes.name: Ocean Sciences
programmes.about: Oceanography, marine ecosystems, climate, data and field methods in the mid-Atlantic. The 180-ECTS degree is fully taught in English, with its first year in Ponta Delgada and the next two in Horta.
programmes.ib: One approved entrance-exam set is required; 2026 options used biology, physics and chemistry, geography or mathematics. Check the 2027 CNAES IB-equivalence table before applying.
programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade and 50% entrance exam(s), with at least 95 of 200 in each and overall. 2026 criteria.

notes: The 2027 national-contest calendar and IB exam-equivalence table are not published yet.
Half of the 2026 places carried an Azores regional preference; the programme still admitted through the national contest.
The course requires moving from São Miguel to Faial after the first year.
